ai.title: AI assistant
ai.intro: Choose the AI powering the assistant: the platform's default AI (with a daily message quota) or your own provider with your API key, encrypted on the server and never shown again.

mode.customHint: Your provider and your key, without quota.
mode.unavailable: This server does not offer a default AI: use your own API key.
mode.active: You are using the default AI.
mode.switchHint: Switching to the default AI will delete your personal configuration (provider and key).

ai.loadError: Could not load your AI settings.
ai.keyHint: Sent once, then stored encrypted on the server.
ai.keyStoredHint: A key is already saved: leave this field empty to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.

models.empty: No matching model at the provider.
models.needsConfig: Fill in the API key (and the server URL when required) to get model suggestions.

probeErrors.badKey: API key rejected by the provider: check it.
probeErrors.invalid: Request rejected by the provider: check the model and the fields.
probeErrors.rateLimited: Provider rate limit or quota reached (the key is valid).
probeErrors.unavailable: Provider unreachable: check the server URL or try again later.
probeErrors.generic: Operation failed: please try again later.

errors.invalid: Settings rejected by the server: check the provider, key and URL.
errors.unavailable: The server cannot store a key right now (encryption not configured).
errors.generic: Could not save: please try again later.
